verdict.rationale: Discord's docs describe an official App Directory where users can browse and discover apps by name, category, or collection, and apps can be shared via links to profile/store pages — functioning like a marketplace for bots/integrations [discord-docs-11][discord-docs-21][discord-docs-29][discord-docs-12]. However, the evidence never explicitly documents a server-admin 'install' flow (e.g., authorizing a bot into a server) distinct from discovery, nor does it show admin-specific permission management UI. Missing for 10: explicit admin-facing install/authorization workflow documentation, screenshots or walkthrough of adding an app to a server, and independent/community confirmation of the install experience.
